blind.description: A traditional wooden library bookcase featuring an upper section divided into two shelf bays filled with colorful books, a brass slide rail along the top with an attached rolling ladder leaning against it, and a lower cabinet section with panel doors and brass knobs. Modeled in a stylized, hand-painted textured aesthetic with clean, solid, continuous surfaces, standing upright directly on its molded base flat on the floor.
blind.from_above: A long, narrow brown rectangle corresponding to the top cornice shelf with slightly flared corner molding, with the slanted top and rungs of the ladder protruding slightly from the front edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 1.3 to 1.4 times taller than the 5 ft 9 in figure (around 7.5 to 8 feet tall) and about 5.5 to 6 feet wide.
